subject: DSCR can change the financing picture
preheader: screen debt coverage, then confirm the lender's written rules.
headline: Model DSCR early, then verify it against the lender's definition.
body: Debt Service Coverage Ratio = NOI / Annual Debt Service. A property generating $24,000 NOI with $20,000 in annual mortgage payments has a DSCR of 1.20.

Investor-loan programs do not all use the same minimum, rent basis, expense treatment, leverage, reserves, or interest-rate terms. A screening ratio is useful context, but it cannot establish eligibility or approval.
Financing assumptions can change the result materially. Stress the rate, down payment, rent, vacancy, and expenses instead of treating one base case as a lender decision.

Model DSCR before relying on a financing scenario. A modeled 1.18 and 1.32 indicate different screening cushions, but neither determines lender eligibility or tells you whether or how to offer. Confirm the lender's written DSCR definition, rent basis, leverage, reserves, and other program rules.

When available, TrueCap starts with an editable FRED 30-year owner-occupied mortgage-rate benchmark—not an investor loan quote. Replace it with a current written lender quote and confirm the lender's calculation before relying on the modeled DSCR. The preliminary rental screen is available on Free.
